tiers.name: restricted
tiers.label: Restricted
tiers.purpose: Secrets and high-impact business data with strong legal or financial exposure.
examples: agent/service-account credentials and one-time issued machine tokens
password hashes and auth signing keys
temporary default test credentials (for example admin/123456)
backend environment overrides containing real secrets
signed and system-generated legal/financial contract artifacts
supplier bank account names, account numbers, branches, and bank routing codes

storage: Secrets only in .env or secret manager
Restricted business records only in the application database or protected contract-evidence storage
Least privilege file mode (<=600 for backend .env)
Contract artifact directories use 0700 and files use 0600
transfer: Do not paste into tickets/chat unless redacted
controls.retention: Rotate on role change; remove stale values within 24h of lifecycle end

tiers.name: confidential
tiers.label: Confidential
tiers.purpose: Business-sensitive internal data that is not publicly shareable.

storage: Use role-based filtering at API response layer
transfer: Mask identifiers in non-prod shared environments
controls.retention: Keep no longer than product/legal requirement; archive with access audit

tiers.name: internal
tiers.label: Internal
tiers.purpose: General internal information for team coordination and operation.
examples: ByteRover engineering memory that excludes secrets and business-sensitive data

controls.retention: Keep in repository history as needed and clean when obsolete
